test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Lake Pangong Tso is the water body shared by India and ______.
solution:
The correct answer is **__China.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lake Pangong Tso is located in **Laddakh** union territory and is an endorheic lake in the Himalayas situated at a height of about **4,350m.**
 
• It is geographically situated in a disputed territory claimed both by India and China.
 
• The lake is about **5 km wide and about 134km long **with about **60% of the length extending into Tibet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Bay of Bengal is the northeastern part of the Indian Ocean, bounded on the west and northwest by India, on the north by **Bangladesh, and on the east by Myanmar and the Andaman and Nicobar Islands of India.**
 
• There are 56 rivers that flow down from the Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan to the eastern state of Assam in India to meet the **Brahmaputra River**.
 
• The **Sharda River**, also called Kali river and** Mahakali River, originates at Kalapani in the Himalayas at an elevation of 3,600 m in the Pithoragarh district in Uttarakhand, India.**
